train: The original 600 rows, 306 empirically all-tied, 294 other rows, and original 1/600 normalization

linear.middle_cell: reuse original B/C, fit four new heads

mlp.architecture: frozen PCA16 features, 16-unit tanh hidden layer, 20 outputs, 612 parameters
mlp.optimization: full-batch float64 Adam, 2400 fixed cosine-schedule steps .01 to .001, lowest penalized training objective, then output head convex epigraph refinement with hidden features fixed
mlp.training_selection: training objective only; all seeds reported

deployment.P: uniform on the highest frozen train600 integer success count within the same set

evaluation.role: exploratory diagnostics on the already observed frozen E24 cohort
evaluation.uncertainty: stratified question-paired standard error for fully identified contrasts and descriptive min/max across the three recorded seeds; no confidence interval or bootstrap
evaluation.missing_rewards: use exact closed-score support; report exact binary-completion bounds for full-cohort contrasts and actual full-support coverage; do not impute or evaluate new LLM calls
